name: Standard Contract Summarization
description: Template for generating structured summaries of legal contracts

parameters.name: contractTitle
parameters.description: Title of the contract being summarized

parameters.name: focusAreas
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of areas to focus on

parameters.name: includeObligations
parameters.description: Whether to include party obligations in summary

parameters.name: includeFinancialTerms
parameters.description: Whether to include financial terms in summary

parameters.name: includeTermination
parameters.description: Whether to include termination clauses in summary
